main_body: stone tower with a conical green-tiled roof
top_band: green-teal shingled roof slope from row 4 to row 40 (with gold finial at rows 0-3)
evidence: The building has a large, clearly defined sloped roof surface (rows 4-40) above a vertical stone front wall (rows 41-95). Row 41 is a dark eave shadow beneath the roof edge, and the window (rows 50-63) and arched door (rows 68-91) are recessed with inner shadows.

style.evidence: While the roof has a decent 6-step green ramp with individual shingle shading, the stone wall (rows 42-91) is composed of large, uniform, flat-filled geometric blocks (each block is roughly 7x3 pixels of solid flat grey without internal speckle or stone texture), unlike the richly speckled and individually shaded stones/plaster in the Beodeul references.
